verdict.rationale: Missive's evidence supports AI triage mainly through agents: the changelog pitches letting an agent triage new conversations against your CRM and having Claude summarize your inbox via MCP, with permissions you choose. Auditability is supported by the session tab showing what the assistant is doing and by logging of every action. Labeling automation is shown only through classic rules, not AI-driven categorization. Missing for 10: native built-in AI auto-labeling/categorization, documented priority surfacing of what needs attention, documented ways to steer triage behavior (instructions/policies), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
